items.description: Former India head coach Ravi Shastri is disappointed that Mohammed Shami did not get another chance in India's Test team before announcing his retirement from the format. items.title: Musk funded Flint school water filters & laptops in 2018; pledged to fix water in homes
items.author: TOI TECH DESK
items.description: In 2018, Elon Musk’s foundation donated significant funds to install water filtration systems in Flint schools. The donation enabled students to access clean drinking water for the first time in years. Prior to the installation, the district relied on bottled water. Despite the support, community leaders emphasized that replacing the infrastructure is crucial for long-term recovery. Flint's officials continue working on projects to restore trust in the city's water system.

items.title: Inside B'luru murders: Mutton curry invite, sleeping pills, TV blaring, bodies in bags
items.author: RAJIV KALKOD
items.description: S Indushekhar reportedly killed his wife Sunitha and six of her relatives at their rented house. Following the murders, he and his daughter disposed of the bodies in various locations. Investigators believe that financial disputes related to gold jewellery may have motivated the killings. The police have found several bodies and are investigating further connections to the crime. Indushekhar's actions stem from a long-standing marital conflict exacerbated by family support.

items.title: Deepinder Goyal walks back on 'Dear concerned Indian doctors' post
items.author: TOI TECH DESK
items.description: Deepinder Goyal has issued an apology to Indian doctors following criticism of his new health wearable, Temple. He expressed regret for generalizing about all doctors and clarified his frustrations were directed at specific influencer doctors. Goyal emphasized that Temple is backed by scientific research and aims to provide independent validation soon. The wearable device monitors various health metrics and is designed to operate without a microphone.
